tools.name: list_activities
tools.title: List activities
tools.description: List the signed-in user's trackable baby activities (Feeding, Sleep, Diaper, etc.) with their id, kind (instant or timed) and configurable fields. Call this first to get an activity id before logging.

tools.name: list_logs
tools.title: List logs
tools.description: List the signed-in user's baby log entries between two ISO timestamps, oldest first. Use it to answer questions like how much the baby slept or ate in a period.

from.description: Start of the range, ISO 8601 timestamp (inclusive).

to.description: End of the range, ISO 8601 timestamp (exclusive).

activity_id.description: Optional activity id to filter by.

tools.name: create_log
tools.title: Log an activity
tools.description: Record a baby log entry for the signed-in user. Use list_activities first to get the activity id and its fields. For a timed activity, omit ended_at and set start_timer to true to start a running timer, or provide ended_at to record a completed session.

started_at.description: ISO 8601 start time. Defaults to now.

ended_at.description: ISO 8601 end time for a completed timed entry.

start_timer.description: Timed activities only: leave the entry running instead of completing it.

values.description: Field values keyed by the activity's field keys, e.g. { amount: 4, method: 'Bottle - Formula' }.

tools.name: get_running_timer
tools.title: Get running timer
tools.description: Return the signed-in user's currently running timed log entry (one with no end time), or null when nothing is running.

tools.name: stop_timer
tools.title: Stop timer
tools.description: Stop a running timed log entry for the signed-in user by setting its end time to now. Use get_running_timer to find the id.

id.description: Id of the running log entry.

ended_at.description: ISO 8601 end time. Defaults to now.

tools.name: get_baby_profile
tools.title: Get baby profile
tools.description: Return the signed-in user's baby profile, including the baby's name.
